title: cotyledon orbiculata var. oblonga
intro: Cotyledon orbiculata var. oblonga, commonly known as the String of Hearts or Chain of Hearts, is a succulent plant species belonging to the family Asclepiadaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve heart health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotyledon orbiculata var. oblonga include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
